name: Surface Mount Technology Corp.
old_description: Electronics Manufacturing for Complex Products That Need to Work
about:
Surface Mount Technology Corporation (SMT) was founded in 1997 in Appleton, Wisconsin. The company operates as an electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider, offering engineering, prototyping, production, test, and higher-level assembly for original equipment manufacturers.

SMT delivers a connected suite of services that spans electronic design engineering, new product introduction, printed circuit board assembly, conformal coating, in-circuit and functional testing, custom test fixture development, supply chain management, and final product integration including enclosure assembly, cabling, labeling, serialization, and packaging. The company runs a state-of-the-art facility in Appleton, though its square footage and headcount are not publicly disclosed.

The firm serves OEMs in industrial controls, instrumentation, test and measurement, automation, medical and medical-adjacent electronics, transportation and mobility, energy and environmental technology, and safety and security systems. Customers typically engage SMT when they need engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, test, and assembly to function as a single execution system rather than a series of handoffs.

SMT says its differentiation lies in quoting only what it can actually build, aligning design with execution early, using real-time operating visibility across work orders, material readiness, and capacity, supporting the full product lifecycle from concept through sustaining support, and being right-sized for complex OEM programs with the responsiveness of a smaller organization.
built_on: Quotes only what can actually be built after reviewing material cost, lead time, and execution risk
Aligns design with execution early by bringing engineering, sourcing, test, and manufacturing into product development
Uses real-time operating visibility across work order status, routing, material readiness, labor content, queue time, and capacity
Supports the full product lifecycle from requirements and design through prototyping, NPI, production, test, higher-level assembly, and sustaining support
Right-sized for complex OEM programs with systems and discipline of a large EMS partner but greater responsiveness and accountability
type_evidence: SMT helps OEMs develop, launch, manufacture, test, and support complex electronic products by connecting engineering, prototyping, supply chain, manufacturing, test, and higher-level assembly into one execution system.
